verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself an AI agent that works over the user's own data. It can query large codebases, debug in natural language and ingest PDFs and images. It also produces automated PR reviews with contextual suggestions and content-based issue triage. Hands-on reports praise its large-codebase comprehension and say its code-review tips caught real bugs, though some users call its codebase navigation weak. Missing for 10: evidence of insight generation over non-code data such as datasets or documents beyond app generation, and documented depth on how the insights and suggestions are surfaced beyond code review and triage.
